subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: What should OpenClaw do for vLLM/local-provider cost visibility when token usage is present but local pricing is zero or missing?
rationale: The code already supports vLLM streaming token usage, but cost visibility depends on a product contract that must distinguish intentional free/local models from unpriced paid models.

options.title: Keep Evidence-Gated
options.body: Keep this issue open for raw vLLM stream, transcript, and Usage API evidence, and route any confirmed cost-only gap to the existing unknown-pricing issue.

options.title: Fold Into Pricing Issue
options.body: If maintainers accept that vLLM tokens are already handled and only cost visibility remains, close this as overlapping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674.

options.title: Close As Implemented
options.body: If maintainers accept the latest release's request/parse/aggregation path and docs as sufficient without reporter proof, this can be closed as implemented.

recommendation.title: Keep Evidence-Gated
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for raw vLLM stream, transcript, and Usage API evidence, and route any confirmed cost-only gap to the existing unknown-pricing issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history ties usage-cost reporting, vLLM streaming-usage enablement, and zero-rate cost handling to this owner path.
